_doc: Build spec v10 of 2026-11-13, exported from rebuild-comp-v10.html (the approved comp, doc 21 section 12). Positions live in opzet-layout-v10.json; this file holds what a slot map cannot: table column widths and row heights, hero bar domains, chart axis ends and end-label positions, the F4 name boxes, the number formatters, and under 'text' the exact visible strings of every slot in every view (P1; P2 Recommended, What waits and Build in Low, Expected and High; Build with nothing picked). Build views use the opening selection (package A's three moves). Strings are given without the U+2060 word joiner the formatters put between the sign and the $. Table cells are lists of rows; a line break inside a cell is \n (UNICHAR(10)). Use the strings as DAX assertion targets for the text measures. Reasons and rules: project-state/active/22-rebuild-comp-v10-handoff-2026-11-13.md.

text_metrics.font: Segoe UI 400 and Segoe UI Semibold 600
text_metrics.line_height: 1.33 x font size: 12 pt (16 px) = 21.3 px, 14 pt = 24.9 px, 20 px = 26.6 px, 28 pt = 49.6 px
text_metrics.overflow_rule: a text slot is too small when its lines need more than 2 px beyond its height

formatters.money: $ + one decimal + M; two decimals only when one decimal would show 0.0 (+$0.03M)
formatters.sign: + or U+2212, then U+2060 WORD JOINER, then $ (Chrome and Power BI otherwise break the line after the minus)

tbl_hero.grid: one hairline (Dusk) under the header, nothing else
columns: Status (A #1763A8, 2028 gate Night, not now Dusk)
A year on cost bar (SVG 196 x 34)

bar_cell.fill: Move Status Color: A #2589D8, 2028 gate #12233D, not now #8E897D

tbl_moves.aligns_with: sl_moves rows (32 px each, from y 280)

ch_plan_cum.end_labels: one data label on 2032 per line, text "Low −$4.6M" from the label-safe format string, position Right, white background; selected case #1763A8 semibold

ch_cmp_alts.y: auto, one tick below zero, 8% headroom above the top line

ch_plan_bar.why: the amounts sit in c_plan_t1..t4 above each segment; in-bar labels repeated them and two failed 4.5:1

ch_f4.close_neighbours: F4 Row Y: hotels within one point of a neighbour in the same row alternate -0.3, +0.3, -0.3 ... in order of 2025 occupancy (so Gatwick sits 0.3 below the Airport row and Montreal 0.3 above)
ch_f4.names: seven text boxes lbl_f4_* (static: P1 does not follow the scenario)

hero_s_packages.discs: A #2589D8, B and C #12233D, r 11, white letter
hero_s_packages.you: Night marker r 6 (Tangerine over budget) drawn under the discs; "You" label above it on white

P1.z_eyebrow: 1 / 2 · THE WAKE-UP CALL · THE BRAND REVIEW
P1.z_headline: Full rooms, a slipping margin: Goodnight Inn pays the middleman, and its welcome is fading.
P1.c_subtitle: Goodnight Inn in 2025, against the three other Pillow & Key Group brands. For the Board: what is wrong, before page 2 says what to fund.
P1.kpi_occ:
F4 · Occupancy
79.4%
best of 4, the others 64.7% to 72.9%
P1.kpi_margin:
F1 · Operating margin after commissions
33.7%
2nd of 4, −2.8 pt since 2023
P1.kpi_ota:
F2 · Room revenue booked through online agencies
50.0%
highest of 4, 33.0% in 2021
P1.kpi_nps:
F3 · Guest quality: net promoter score (−100 to +100)
+3.3
still positive, but falling every year, last of 4
P1.c_f1_title: After commissions, the margin fell 2.8 points since 2023
P1.c_f1_note: Commissions took 1.0 of those points and running costs 1.8 (staff rose from 26.9% to 28.3% of revenue). Room rates rose 2.7%, in line with the other brands, so no price premium absorbs it.
P1.lnk_f1: → Page 2: revenue management and the kiosks.
P1.c_f2_title: Online agencies now book 50% of room revenue, up from 33%
P1.c_f2_note: Booked direct, the guest pays $2.25 more and we keep $17.47 more. Nothing rewards the guest for booking direct; member rates change that. At the 2021 channel mix, 2025 commissions would be $4.8M lower.
P1.lnk_f2: → Page 2: the booking app with member rates.
P1.c_f3_title: Hotels last renovated 10 years or more ago score NPS −4.9
P1.c_f3_count: 44 of 50 hotels; 6 have no renovation date.
P1.c_f3_note: Since 2018 Goodnight Inn spent $1.0M per hotel on renovation; the other brands spent $5.9M to $7.9M. None has started since 2020. Older hotels lose guest loyalty before they lose rooms: an association, not proof of cause.
P1.lnk_f3: → Page 2: the refresh waits for the 2028 gate, and why.
P1.c_f4_title: Our airports run full: Toronto topped 90% occupancy in 17 of the last 24 months
P1.c_f4_note: Gatwick did in 14, Montréal in 13; Kingston, the third extension on offer, in none.
P1.lnk_f4: → Page 2: kiosks at the 20 busiest hotels; extensions decided at the 2028 gate.
P1.z_footer: Source: Pillow & Key Group dataset, Power BI Dataviz World Champs 2027. Guest scores weighted by survey responses; 2021 is a depressed base year.
P1.btn_next: Next: what we fund, and why →
